text: nice job can we take it up a notch and have the door push back the player when it opens that way its truly a physics object it currently just goes thru me D:
resolution: Made the swinging cooked door a real physical object that shoves the player. Previously the leaf's collision rect sat at the CLOSED pose and then parked (vanished) past half-open, so the moving panel clipped through the player. Now stepCookedDoors recomputes the rect to TRACK the swinging leaf every frame and keeps it solid the whole time: the rect center pivots about the hinge (engine m4rotateY convention) and its half-extents fold by the leaf's TOTAL angle (instance yaw + swing) from the leaf's stored LOCAL half-extents, so the sweeping door pushes the player out of the way exactly like the elevator car carries a standing player. Fully open the panel lies along the jamb so the doorway stays walkable. Loader-only, builds clean ReleaseFast, rjit game shot PASS. User re-compiles + runs the rebuilt loader to feel it; if it's too shove-y/janky or wedges the player in a tight doorway, the follow-ups are softening the push or a 'blocked -> door waits' fallback.
